description.narrative: The Project Preparatory Facility for Energy (the Facility) is intended to prepare a series of hydropower projects and related transmission infrastructure for development in Nepal, emphasizing private sector participation and regional integration. The Facility will support for project preparatory activities of selected candidate hydropower projects and Kohalpur- Surkhet-Upper Karnali 400kV Transmission Line, Kohalpur-New Butwal 400kV Transmission Line, and produce a set of bankable documents. The study includes feasibility study and environmental / social impact assessments (EIA/SIA) etc. The hydropower projects for such study will be selected from various candidate projects being considered for development through private or public / public-private sectors.

Status as of 30 Sept 2025 (i) Dudh Koshi Storage Hydropower Project. The consultant submitted the final detailed design reports including bidding documents in November 2024 after the draft documents were reviewed by the panel of experts in October 2024. The consultant's contract has been extended until 31 December 2025 for the continued support needed for the EIA approval and preparing documents compliant with the requirement of the financiers including ADB's Environmental and Social Framework 2024. Out of total contract amount of $7.3 million, $6.4 million has been disbursed and $0.84 million remains to be disbursed. The project anticipates a cost variation in the contract for the continued inputs in the extended period. The loan project is in ADB pipeline for approval in 2026.
(ii) (iii) Lower Seti Hydropower Project. THL briefed the Mission regarding the status of the proposed 126 MW Lower Seti project, for which a Detailed Project Report (DPR) has been prepared using a technical assistance grant from ADB. The updated feasibility study and detailed design along with the bidding documents have been finalized. EIA report has been submitted to the Ministry of Forest and Environment for approval and presentation was done on 24 July 2024. Consultant support is required for the preparation of the until the government approves the EIA. Out of total contract amount of $2.05 million, $1.2 million has been disbursed and $0.85 million remains to be disbursed. The Mission advised THL to work as quicky as possible to address ADB's comments on the EIA and social safeguards reports prepared for the project, and to prepare a comments matrix highlighting any additional resources that are required from ADB to fully address all comments. To ensure that comments can be adequately addressed to meet ADB's safeguards requirements, the Mission requested THL to ensure that the DPR consultants to incorporate any environment-related directives into the design of the hydropower plant and engage other experts as needed. Mission also underscored the importance of addressing various safeguards and other implementation issues of the ongoing Tanahu Hydropower Project before proceeding with the Lower Seti Hydropower project which is on standby for 2028 approval in ADB pipeline.
